decision: **Opus across the board: builds, reviews, fixes and briefs (replaces D52).** Every background session runs on Opus; a row or brief that says Sonnet does not override this. Effort stays medium unless a brief asks for more. The rest stands: a call budget and a kill criterion per job, no polling by agents, at most 4 background sessions (D59).
